# YAML step reference

<!-- Generated by `python docs/generate_step_reference.py`; do not edit. -->

Every step is a one-key mapping. Built-in action names are collected from `testbench.core.steps.Action`.

| Action | Example |
| --- | --- |
| `open` | `- open: https://example.test` |
| `click` | `- click: Sign in` |
| `type` | `- type: {field: Email, value: ${EMAIL}}` |
| `wait` | `- wait: 1` |
| `screenshot` | `- screenshot: after_login` |
| `expect_visible` | `- expect_visible: Dashboard` |
| `expect_text` | `- expect_text: Welcome` |
| `expect_url_contains` | `- expect_url_contains: /home` |
| `expect_enabled` | `- expect_enabled: {target: Submit, enabled: true}` |
| `select_option` | `- select_option: {field: Country, value: Canada}` |
| `scroll` | `- scroll: {direction: down, amount: 500}` |
| `swipe` | `- swipe: {direction: up}` |
| `scroll_to` | `- scroll_to: Settings` |
| `back` | `- back: true` |
| `home` | `- home: true` |
| `hide_keyboard` | `- hide_keyboard: true` |
| `press_key` | `- press_key: Enter` |
| `set_orientation` | `- set_orientation: landscape` |
| `wait_for_image` | `- wait_for_image: start.png` |
| `click_image` | `- click_image: start.png` |
| `expect_image` | `- expect_image: score.png` |
| `expect_no_image` | `- expect_no_image: game_over.png` |
| `click_text` | `- click_text: PLAY` |
| `tap` | `- tap: {x: 0.5, y: 0.8}` |
| `drag` | `- drag: {from: [100, 500], to: [100, 200], duration: 0.5}` |
| `hold_key` | `- hold_key: {key: right, seconds: 2}` |
| `wait_for_change` | `- wait_for_change: {region: [0, 0, 800, 600], timeout: 10}` |
| `expect_no_change` | `- expect_no_change: {region: [0, 0, 800, 600], seconds: 5}` |
| `measure_fps` | `- measure_fps: {seconds: 5, min_fps: 30}` |

The JSON schema below is generated directly by Pydantic and is the source of truth for the common `Step` envelope.

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "A normalized automation action.",
  "properties": {
    "action": {
      "enum": [
        "open",
        "click",
        "type",
        "wait",
        "screenshot",
        "expect_visible",
        "expect_text",
        "expect_url_contains",
        "expect_enabled",
        "select_option",
        "scroll",
        "swipe",
        "scroll_to",
        "back",
        "home",
        "hide_keyboard",
        "press_key",
        "set_orientation",
        "wait_for_image",
        "click_image",
        "expect_image",
        "expect_no_image",
        "click_text",
        "tap",
        "drag",
        "hold_key",
        "wait_for_change",
        "expect_no_change",
        "measure_fps"
      ],
      "title": "Action",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "value": {
      "title": "Value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "action",
    "value"
  ],
  "title": "Step",
  "type": "object"
}
```

Target-specific values are validated by the drivers and validators. Custom step plugins contribute their own Pydantic value models.
